clips.title: The story
paras: Return to the Magistrate concludes an urgent reconnaissance dispatch between the eastern border of Tirisfal Glades and the town of Brill. Having reported to Deathguard Linnea at her waystation east of Brill, adventurers are sent back to deliver troubling news directly to Magistrate Sevren. The message confirms that the mindless minions of the Lich King continue to test the borders of the young Forsaken nation.

The eastern road out of Tirisfal Glades leads directly into the blighted ruins of the Western Plaguelands, where the Scourge holds devastating sway. To keep the undead hordes from spilling over into their newly claimed homeland, the Forsaken established the Bulwark—a fortified checkpoint watched from a waystation behind the line by grim sentries like Deathguard Linnea. After gathering reports of what presses against the eastern gate, Linnea sends messengers racing back west along the King's Road toward Brill before enemy infiltrators can capitalize on any gaps.

When Magistrate Sevren receives the dispatch in Brill, it confirms his worst fears: Scourge scouts are finding pathways around or through the frontline perimeter. For the Forsaken, every creeping ghoul and mindless skeleton is not merely a military nuisance, but a reminder of the enslavement they broke free from during the fall of Lordaeron. Sevren remains adamant that no matter how ceaseless the Lich King's onslaught becomes, the free undead will never surrender their newfound autonomy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
But we will not give in. He will not take us again!
